audit.whatIsWrong: The page called this EVEN at 6/10 on a 39.27% win rate, and win[3] said Skill while whys[3] describes him proxying your wave where you cannot reach — clearly his row.
audit.why: The mirror (singed__ksante) rates it FAV 4/10 from Singed's side over the same chart, so this side must read TRICKY at the inverse. The packet chart also has Singed at Levels 4-5.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN -> TRICKY, diffRating 6/10 -> 8/10, tone to the tricky colour, Levels 4-5 flipped to Singed (3/10) in matched pairs; difficulty prose updated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was written around an 'R re-cast yank' that does not exist.
audit.why: K'Sante's R (120/100/80) knocks the target back through a wall and then dashes after them into All Out — there is no recast in Riot's text. Singed's Insanity Potion (100s) also puts Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, which directly cuts All Out's healing.
audit.corrected: Spike rewritten as the wall-launch into All Out, with the Grievous Wounds counter stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was labelled W in five places ('flip (W)', 'flings your carries (W)'). Fling is E (125 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s); W is Mega Adhesive. And the decisive interaction — Mega Adhesive GROUNDS — was missing entirely.
audit.why: Grounding shuts off Path Maker, Footwork and the All Out dash, so a K'Sante standing in the glue has no mobility at all, and Fling exists to put you in it (a target flung into Mega Adhesive is also rooted). That is the whole matchup, and it was not on the page.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected everywhere; the grounding is now in early, mid and wants.foe[1], and the Fling-into-glue root is stated.
sources: kit file: singed W grounding, E text

audit.why: Anti-heal is already called core in the itemisation block, which is right against Insanity Potion's drain-tank profile.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Fling and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 8/10. The lane is decided by whether you fight before Mega Adhesive grounds all three of your dashes.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Singed carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Tricky matchup — difficulty 8/10, Singed carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: His move speed plus flip (W) means he kites every trade you try and your full Q-W combo cannot land on him.
edits.after: His move speed plus Fling (E, 10s) means he kites every trade you try and your full Q-W combo cannot land.

edits.before: All Out and its yank re-cast give you a duelist 1v1 and the one tool that can catch him, making this your even window.
edits.after: R launches him through the wall into All Out — a duelist 1v1 and the one tool that catches him, so this is your even window.

edits.before: He drain-tanks your R's shred and runs your whole team down, and your armor stacking does nothing to a move-speed sustain champ.
edits.after: Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds guts All Out's healing while he runs your team down; armor does nothing to a move-speed sustain champ.

edits.before: Best window to land your Q3 knockup-and-pull before he buys boots and starts proxying out of your range.
edits.after: Best window to land Q3's pull before he buys boots and starts proxying out of your range entirely.

edits.before: All Out gives you a duelist 1v1 and the R re-cast to yank him back, your only real catch on a champ this slippery.
edits.after: R launches him through a wall into All Out — your only real catch, though his R's Grievous Wounds halves your healing.

edits.before: He drain-tanks your shred and runs your whole team down with W flips and poison, while your armor stacking does nothing to his sustain.
edits.after: He runs your team down with Fling (E) and poison, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds cuts All Out's healing while your armor does nothing.

edits.before: Singed barely contests Level 1, so this is your one even window, but you have to land your Q3 knockup-and-pull while he is still standing in your range. The second he gets boots and his poison trail going, he starts proxying behind your tower and your short Q and W can never reach him. Do not chase him into his own poison trail or river brush, because his flip (W) plus move speed will turn a chase into a free kill for him. Farm safely and accept that you cannot pin him down once he is rolling.
edits.after: Singed barely contests Level 1, so this is your one even window, but you have to land Q3's pull while he is still standing in your range. The second he gets boots and his poison trail going, he starts proxying behind your tower and your short Q and W can never reach him. Never stand in Mega Adhesive (W): it grounds, so Path Maker, Footwork and All Out all stop working, and Fling (E) exists to put you exactly there. Farm safely and accept you cannot pin him down once he is rolling.

edits.before: By Levels 4-6 Singed is a proxy machine, and your W wall-stun is the only CC he cannot simply out-speed, so position to flip him into your tower or terrain when he overstays on your wave. At 6 your All Out gives you a real duelist 1v1 and the R re-cast lets you yank him back, but it strips your tank stats, and a fed Singed with poison plus Rylai's slow can kite even your duelist form. Save W to body-block his flip and never face-tank his poison while it ticks. Honestly, if he is farming your wave from behind your tower, you often cannot punish him at all, so play for cross-map pressure instead.
edits.after: By Levels 4-6 Singed is a proxy machine, and your W stun is the only CC he cannot simply out-speed, so position to knock him into your tower or terrain when he overstays on your wave. At 6 your R launches him through a wall into All Out, but it strips your tank stats and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds halves the healing All Out gives back. The real trap is Mega Adhesive: stand in the glue and your W, E and All Out dashes are all grounded, so step out of it before you commit. If he farms your wave from behind your tower, play for cross-map pressure instead.

edits.before: This is where the lane is genuinely lost on a straight 1v1. Singed is a drain-tank who heals through your R's shred, and your armor stacking means nothing against a champ whose whole gameplan is move speed and sustain, not raw burst. He flings your carries (W) and runs your entire team down, and a single CC like your Q3 or W never catches him. Group with your team, use R purely to peel his flips off your backline, and let numbers solve the problem your one-target lockdown never will.
edits.after: This is where the lane is genuinely lost on a straight 1v1. Singed is a drain-tank whose Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on your All Out healing, and your armor stacking means nothing against a champ whose gameplan is move speed and sustain. He flings your carries with E and runs your entire team down, and a single CC like your Q3 or W never catches him. Group with your team, use R purely to peel his flips off your backline, and let numbers solve what your lockdown never will.

edits.before: Catch him with R All Out and the re-cast yank when he dives your backline
edits.after: Catch him with R's wall-launch into All Out when he dives your backline

edits.before: Fling you (W) into his poison trail and run away faster than you can chase
edits.after: Fling you (E) into Mega Adhesive, grounding you so no dash gets you out

notes: Fling was labelled W five times across this matchup — it is E. The mirror's central finding (Mega Adhesive grounds, so a glued K'Sante has no Path Maker, Footwork or All Out) was absent from this side and is now stated in early, mid and wants.foe[1], so the two directions agree. Difficulty moved to TRICKY 8/10 to match the 39.27% win rate and the mirror's FAV 4/10.
